common.company: Forge Studios Tecnologias em Softwares LTDA.

hero.title: All your universes. One identity.
hero.subtitle: Join living communities, find your house, hunt legendary creatures, climb the rankings and meet people who love the same stories you do.

universes.title: Choose where to begin
universes.subtitle: Each universe has its own identity, community and challenges — and new universes keep arriving.

features.title: Built for people who live the stories

identity.title: Identity per universe
identity.body: One account, with its own identity in every universe: your house, your hunter rank and more.

community.title: Communities and groups
community.body: Common rooms, forums, theories and moderated discussions where you can talk safely.

gamification.title: XP, levels and achievements
gamification.body: Quizzes, missions and events with rewards computed on the server — fair for everyone.

events.title: Events and competitions
events.body: House tournaments, hunter challenges and special events all year long.

safety.title: Safety and privacy
safety.body: Data protection under LGPD, active moderation and stronger defaults for minors.

global.title: Brazilian and international
global.body: Portuguese and English from day one, with dates, currencies and time zones in your format.

plans.title: Free forever. Premium if you want.
plans.subtitle: Essential community features are free. Premium plans add customization and exclusive spaces — never ranking advantages.

cta.title: Your next universe is one click away.
cta.body: Create your free account and start building your fan identity.
